name: Bizkaiko Txakolina

known.via: English Wikipedia "Bizkaiko Txakolina" (a wine place on Wikidata)

communes: Anteiglesia De San Esteban#Etxebarri Doneztebeko E

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: Denominación de Origen Calificada, a step above DO for regions with a record of consistent quality. Only Rioja and Priorat hold it.
Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Spain's regional wine tier, below DO.
A single-estate wine of high quality. A pago is a vineyard estate.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Basque Country appellation in the province of Bizkaia. It makes txakoli, a thin, acidic white wine that can be naturally fizzy and is traditionally poured from a height. Hondarrabi Zuri is among the allowed grapes.
